Optimizing Onyx Performance on Slow Connections (Latency & Upload Speed)
October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM

 

Check our Connection Quality Monitor article.

 

 

If you're experiencing lag, freezing charts, or delayed orders on Onyx, the issue is usually not download speed, but latency (ping) and upload stability.

Even if streaming or browsing works fine, trading platforms require a much more stable and responsive connection.

Why This Happens

Onyx depends on real-time communication with trading servers.

For optimal performance, Onyx suggests:

Upload speed of at least 50 Mbps

Low and stable latency

If your connection has:

High latency (80–100ms or higher)

Upload speeds below 50 Mbps

Unstable Wi-Fi or packet loss

You may experience:

Chart freezing or lag

Delayed order execution

“Flatten” not responding instantly

Positions not updating in real time

Step 1: Use the Onyx Desktop App (Recommended)

Before upgrading your internet setup, make sure you are using the Onyx Desktop Application.

The desktop app provides:

No browser-related slowdowns or throttling

More stable data handling

GPU-accelerated chart rendering

Dedicated system resources

This alone can significantly improve performance, especially during high activity periods.

Step 2: The Most Reliable Solution — Use a VPS

A Virtual Private Server (VPS) runs your trading platform on a remote machine located close to the trading servers.

This means:

Much lower latency

Stable, high-speed connection

No dependence on your home internet quality

You connect to the VPS, while it handles execution.

Recommended VPS Providers
QuantVPS (Higher Performance)

https://www.quantvps.com/
Best for traders who want maximum stability and lowest latency.

FXVM (More Affordable Option)

https://fxvm.net/
Good balance between cost and performance for most traders.

When You Should Consider a VPS

You should strongly consider using a VPS if:

Your ping is consistently above ~80ms

Your upload speed is below 50 Mbps or unstable

You’ve experienced lag, freezes, or delayed executions

You trade during volatile sessions

If execution matters to your trading, a VPS is one of the most effective upgrades you can make.

Quick Tips (Without a VPS)

If you are not using a VPS, you can still improve performance by:

Using a wired (Ethernet) connection

Avoiding Wi-Fi when possible

Disabling VPNs

Closing unused apps and browser tabs

Troubleshooting Issues with Onyx
Troubleshooting Issues with Onyx

If you experience issues while using Onyx, most problems can be resolved quickly by checking your connection, browser, or Rithmic settings. Below are the most common issues and how to fix them.

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM

Check our Connection Quality Monitor article.

 

1. Market Data Is Not Updating

Possible Cause: Rithmic connection issue or incorrect gateway selection.

Solution:

Confirm you are logged in with valid Rithmic credentials.

Ensure you selected the correct Rithmic gateway for your location.

Refresh the platform and reconnect.

If prompts appear, re-accept Rithmic agreements.

2. Onyx Will Not Load or Runs Slowly

Possible Cause: Network instability or poor internet connection.

Solution:

Test your internet connection by visiting other sites.

Switch to a wired connection if possible.

Change networks if performance improves elsewhere.

Restart your modem or router.

3. Platform Freezes or Becomes Unresponsive

Possible Cause: System resource limitations or browser overload.

Solution:

Close unused tabs and programs.

Restart your browser or device.

Simplify your layout with fewer charts.

Disable heavy browser extensions.

4. Charts or Interface Display Incorrectly

Possible Cause: Browser cache, corrupted site data, or compatibility problems.

Solution:

Clear your browser cache and site settings.

Update your browser to the latest version.

Try a different browser (Chrome or Edge recommended).

Reload the page.

5. Unable to Log In or Receive Data

Possible Cause: Firewall or security software is blocking Rithmic ports or WebSocket traffic.

Solution:

Disable VPN and test again.

Whitelist Onyx and Rithmic in your firewall or antivirus.

Contact your IT team if on a corporate network.

6. Features Not Working or Platform Unavailable

Possible Cause: System updates, Rithmic maintenance, or platform downtime.

Solution:

Check official DayTraders status announcements.

Wait and retry after a short period.

Contact support if the issue continues.

Quick Checklist

Before contacting support, confirm:

You are logged in using Rithmic credentials.

You selected the nearest Rithmic gateway.

Internet is stable and wired if possible.

Browser is updated and cache cleared.

VPN is turned off.

Still Having Issues?

If problems persist, prepare:

Use a Wired Connection: If possible, switch from Wi-Fi to an Ethernet cable. This significantly reduces latency spikes.

Immediate Refresh: If you notice any lag on the chart, press F5 immediately to resync the data.

Manage the Trade: If a refresh doesn’t fix the visual lag, we recommend closing the trade manually to avoid confusion or unintended losses.

Try Incognito Mode: Trading in a private/incognito window helps by disabling browser extensions that might be slowing down your data feed.

Then contact support for assistance.

Connecting MotiveWave to Rithmic

Follow this simple guide to download, install, and configure MotiveWave to start trading efficiently with DayTraders.

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM

 

Some MotiveWave users may want to connect multiple trading platforms to their Rithmic account. In order to avoid paying multiple platform fees you can use Rithmic R|Trader Pro to feed data to your trading platforms (including MotiveWave). Here are the instructions:

Step 1: Download and Install MotiveWave

Download: Visit MotiveWave's download page and download the software.

Install: Follow the on-screen instructions to install MotiveWave on your computer.

 

Step 2: Initial Configuration

Launch MotiveWave: Open the application after installation.

First Screen: Click Next to proceed.

Second Screen: Read and agree to the terms by clicking I Agree.

 

Third Screen: Enter your license key to activate the software.

Step 3: Create Your Workspace

Fourth Screen:

Name your workspace DayTraders.

Set the workspace location to MotiveWave Cloud.

Click Next.

Step 4: Connect Your Account

Fifth Screen:

Enter your account number.

Click Test Connection to ensure proper connectivity.

 

Sixth Screen:

Enter your password.

Configure the dropdown options as required (refer to the instructions provided).

Wait 10–15 seconds for confirmation. Once connected, you will receive a success message.

 

Step 5: Complete Setup

Seventh Screen: Click Finish to finalize the setup.

 

Login Reload:

The client login screen will reload.

Select the DayTraders workspace you created earlier.

Click Continue.

Step 6: Offline Mode Setup

On your first login:

Instead of clicking Connect, select Work Offline.

This step initializes your workspace without pulling live data.

 

Close the application using the Shutdown option.

Step 7: Finalize Connection

Reopen MotiveWave and select your workspace.

Enter your password.

Ensure the system is set to:

Server: DayTraders.com

Remember My Password: On

Click Connect to access your trading environment.

Your MotiveWave client is now fully configured and ready for trading. If you encounter any issues, refer to the support documentation or contact the DayTraders support team for assistance.

 

With this guide, you’ve successfully downloaded, set up MotiveWave, and connected it to Rithmic. Whether you’re placing your first trade or integrating multiple platforms, you’re now ready to leverage MotiveWave’s powerful tools. Happy trading!

NinjaTrader Trade Copier – Complete Setup Guide
NinjaTrader Trade Copier – Complete Setup Guide

Version 2.1.3.2 · Free for all NinjaTrader 8 traders · No license. No subscription. No limits.

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM
What Is Trade Copier?

Trade Copier is a free, professional-grade order replication tool for NinjaTrader 8. Place a trade on one account and it instantly copies to as many accounts as you want.

Note: NinjaTrader is not officially supported. Some traders connect it through Rithmic, but we can’t help with setup or connection issues.

It supports market orders, limit orders, stop orders, modifications, cancellations, and OCO brackets — all replicated automatically with sub-millisecond latency. No cloud servers. No external relay. No added delay.

Who Is This For?

Trade Copier is built for anyone managing multiple accounts on NinjaTrader 8:

Prop firm traders managing multiple funded accounts

Traders running evaluations across several prop firms simultaneously

Personal traders mirroring a sim account to live accounts

Works with any NinjaTrader 8 connection: Rithmic, CQG, Tradovate, or simulation.

System Requirements

Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)

NinjaTrader 8 (latest version recommended)

Two or more connected accounts in NinjaTrader

Internet connection

Installation Guide
Step 1: Download and Install

Close NinjaTrader completely — make sure it is not running in the system tray.

Download the installer: TradeCopierSetup.exe

Right-click the installer and select Run as Administrator.

Step 2: Log In to NinjaTrader

Open NinjaTrader 8 and log in with your NinjaTrader account credentials.

 

Step 3: Open the Tools Menu

Click Tools in the top menu bar of the NinjaTrader Control Center.

 

Step 4: Open Settings

From the Tools dropdown, click Settings at the bottom of the list.

 

Step 5: Enable Multi-Provider

In the Settings window:

Select General on the left

Find Multi-provider in the Preferences section

Check the box

Click OK to save

 

⚠️ This step is required. Trade Copier will not work without Multi-provider enabled.

Step 6: Open Connections

Click Connections in the top menu bar, then click configure at the bottom of the dropdown.

Step 7: Add Your Broker Connection

In the Connections window:

Find your broker in the Available list on the left (e.g. Rithmic for NinjaTrader Brokerage)

Enter your Username and Password on the right

If using Rithmic, set the System dropdown to your provider (e.g. DayTraders.com)

Click Apply to save

 

Repeat this for each account you want to connect.

Step 8: Connect Your Accounts

Go back to Connections in the top menu and click your connection name to connect. A green circle next to the connection name confirms it is live.

Repeat for all accounts you want to use.

Step 9: Launch Trade Copier

Click New in the top menu bar and select Trade Copier at the bottom of the list.

If Trade Copier does not appear in the New menu, see the Troubleshooting section below.

Step 10: Configure Trade Copier

The Trade Copier window opens. Use the right sidebar to:

Select your Instrument (e.g. MNQ JUN26)

Select your Leader account (the account you will trade on)

Select your Method (how orders are replicated to followers)

Step 11: Enable Followers and Go Live

Click each follower account card to toggle it ON (green). The status indicator in the top-right corner will show ONLINE when Trade Copier is active.

Any trade placed on the leader account will now copy instantly to all enabled followers.

Features

Feature

	

Details




Order Replication

	

Copies market, limit, and stop orders to all active followers




Order Modification

	

Change limit, stop, or quantity — followers update automatically




Order Cancellation

	

Cancel on leader, all follower orders cancel




OCO Brackets

	

OCO relationships replicate intact across followers




5 Replication Methods

	

Exact Quantity, Equal Split, Ratio, Cash Weighted, NetLiq Weighted




Cross-Order Trading

	

Trade mini on leader, copy as micro to followers. 21 pairs supported




Activity Log

	

Full log with timestamps, selectable text, one-click copy




Sub-ms Latency

	

Local execution. No cloud, no relay, no delay




100% Free

	

No license, no subscription, no per-trade fee

Replication Methods

Exact Quantity — Copies the exact same quantity to every follower.

Equal Split — Divides leader quantity evenly across active followers.

Ratio — Multiplies by a per-follower ratio. Each follower can have a different ratio.

Cash Weighted — Distributes by available cash. Bigger accounts get more contracts.

NetLiq Weighted — Uses net liquidation instead of cash. Better with open positions.

Cross-Order Trading

Trade a mini contract on the leader and copy it as a micro to followers. Enable per-follower using the CROSS toggle.

Supported pairs: ES/MES, NQ/MNQ, YM/MYM, RTY/M2K, CL/MCL, GC/MGC, NG/QG, 6A/M6A, 6B/M6B, 6E/M6E, 6J/M6J, 6S/M6S, ZS/YK, ZC/XC, ZW/YW, HO/QH, RB/QU, ICD/MICD, IJY/MIJY, ISF/MISF, NF/MNF

Troubleshooting

Trade Copier is not in the New menu: Check that TradeCopier.dll is in Documents > NinjaTrader 8 > bin > Custom. Restart NinjaTrader after confirming.

 

No follower accounts are showing Make sure all accounts are connected first. Select a leader account — the leader is automatically excluded from the follower list.

 

Orders are not copying Check that the follower card is toggled ON (green). Verify the instrument matches on both accounts. Check the LOG tab for errors.

 

Multi-provider error Go to Tools > Settings > General and make sure the Multi-provider checkbox is checked.

Connecting Sierra Chart to Rithmic

Learn how to connect Sierra Chart to Rithmic with this easy guide.

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM

For updated instructions on how to connect Sierra Chart to Rithmic, please visit their connection guide.

 

Sierra Chart offers full support for the Rithmic trading platform, allowing access to the exchanges that Rithmic provides.

 

Steps for Setup

Review the Market Data Policy
Begin by reading the Rithmic Market Data and Support Policy to ensure you're familiar with their requirements and restrictions.

Broker Support
To use Rithmic with Sierra Chart, you’ll need an account with a broker or trading service that supports the Rithmic platform. Confirm with your broker that they provide Rithmic as an option.

Obtain Credentials
Your broker will supply the connection details needed to link Rithmic to Sierra Chart, including a username and password specific to your Rithmic account.

Required Service Package
Ensure you are subscribed to Service Package 10 or higher to access the Rithmic service through Sierra Chart.

Account Identifier Length
Double-check that your broker's account identifier is no longer than 31 characters. Any identifier exceeding this length will prevent correct functionality.

Update Sierra Chart
Update to the latest version of Sierra Chart by following the Fast Update Instructions. This is a crucial step to ensure compatibility with Rithmic.

Set up in Sierra Chart
In Sierra Chart, navigate to Global Settings > Data/Trade Service Settings.

 

Choose Rithmic
In the Main Settings tab, open the Current Selected Service drop-down list and select Rithmic Direct - DTC [Trading].

 

Confirm and Close
After selecting Rithmic, click OK to close the settings window. Wait 5-10 seconds for Sierra Chart to retrieve the server list from Rithmic.

Reload Service Settings
Reopen the Data/Trade Service Settings by selecting it again from the Global Settings menu. The list of servers should now be available in the Service Settings > Server list.

Choose Your Server
From the Server list, select the one your broker has provided. If the list is empty, try closing and reopening the settings window again. If the problem persists, wait for an hour and try once more as the Rithmic server may be unresponsive.

Servers labeled with "Paper Trading" are for simulation accounts, while others are for live trading.

Enter Your Credentials
In the Service Settings, input your Rithmic trading username and password. Be careful, as these fields are case-sensitive—enter them exactly as given by your broker.

Market Data
To receive market data, you will need the Denali Exchange Data Feed. Refer to the Rithmic Market Data and Support Policy for more information.

Historical Data Settings
Under the Common Settings tab, adjust the Maximum Number of Historical Intraday Days to Download according to your needs (generally, this should be set to 186).

Adjust Intraday Storage
In the same Common Settings tab, set the Intraday Data Storage Time Unit as required.

Confirm Settings
Click OK to finalize and close the Data/Trade Service Settings window.

Connect to Servers
To establish a connection, go to File > Connect to Data Feed.

Error Handling
If the Message Log window shows any error messages when attempting to connect, go to File > Disconnect to stop the connection attempts. Review the setup steps again, and retry connecting by selecting File > Connect to Data Feed. If the issue persists, consult the troubleshooting section below.

Common Errors
Some common Rithmic connection errors may appear in the Sierra Chart Message Log. For example:

"Permission Denied" errors can occur when your credentials or permissions are not set correctly. Follow the steps in the Permission Denied Resolution Procedure for more information.

Open a Chart or Trading DOM
To open a Historical Chart, Intraday Chart, or Trading DOM, select File > Find Symbol. Choose the desired symbol and press the relevant button to open it.

If the symbol you need is missing from the list, you can manually enter it by looking it up in the Rithmic R|Trader software. Symbols generally follow the format [symbol].[exchange].

 

Update Symbol List
If no symbols are listed in the Find Symbol window, go to Global Settings > Symbol Settings > Update From Server and wait for the list to refresh.

Update Existing Chartbooks
To update symbols in your existing chartbooks, go to Edit > Translate Symbols to Current Service in Sierra Chart.

Market Data Issues
If you experience market data issues and are not using the Denali Exchange Data Feed, consult the Rithmic Market Data and Support Policy for further information.

EUREX Data
If you need EUREX data, make sure to review the section on EUREX Historical and Real-time Data.

Continue Setup
For further setup guidance, refer to step 3 in the Getting Started documentation.

Exchange Traded Spreads and Strategies

Rithmic supports exchange-traded spreads and strategies. Follow these steps to set up an Intraday chart or Trading DOM for these:

Locate the Symbol
Use the Symbol Lookup feature in Rithmic’s R|Trader software to find the spread or strategy symbol you need.

Enter the Symbol
In Sierra Chart, select File > Find Symbol and input the spread/strategy symbol in the format [spread symbol].[exchange], e.g., NGH3-NGZ3.NYMEX.

Open Chart or DOM
Press Open Intraday Chart or Open Trading DOM to load the data.

Rithmic Symbol Format

Rithmic symbols generally follow this structure: [futures symbol].[exchange], e.g., ESM1.CME. You can look up these symbols through the R|Trader software provided by Rithmic. Contact your broker for more information.

Troubleshooting Frequent Reconnections

If you experience frequent disconnections and reconnections while using Rithmic data, non-standard symbols in your Sierra Chart setup could be causing the issue. Check your charts, watch lists, quote boards, and any other relevant lists for symbols not following the [symbol].[exchange] format and either correct or remove them.

Rithmic Market Data and Support Policy

It’s crucial to read the Rithmic Market Data and Support Policy when using Sierra Chart with Rithmic, particularly for market data. Issues such as frequent disconnections, slow data updates, and missing historical data are known with Rithmic. For a more reliable experience, Sierra Chart recommends using the Denali Exchange Data Feed. Sierra Chart does not provide technical support for problems with Rithmic market data or trading functionality.

Permission Denied Error

If you encounter a "Permission Denied" error, review your connection settings carefully. This error message typically indicates issues with username, password, or server settings. Follow these steps:

Ensure your Trading Username and Password are correct.

Check if the credentials are too long (greater than 31 characters).

Ensure you’ve signed all necessary agreements with Rithmic by logging into the R-Trader software.

 

DayTraders only offers limited support for platform related issues. If you experience any issues with your platform, please contact their platform support directly.

Enter Account Information

Apply Changes

Close Connection Window

Choose Your Account

Begin Trading

Connection Issues
If you encounter a connection error, follow these steps:

Set State to OFF, click Apply.

Then set State to ON and click Apply again.

Avoid Trading on Multiple Platforms
Do not trade the same account on both VolFix and another platform simultaneously.

Account Security
Your login information is securely stored on the VolFix servers. All credentials are encrypted during storage and transmission. VolFix staff cannot access your login or password information.

Journaling System – Quick Start Guide
Journaling System – Quick Start Guide

Everything you need to master automated trade journaling with AI-powered insights

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM

The Journaling System is a fully automated trading journal designed to help you analyze performance, identify patterns, and improve execution using AI-powered insights. Every trade is captured automatically, summarized intelligently, and visualized clearly so you spend less time journaling and more time trading.

Estimated read time is five minutes.

 

1. What Is the Journaling System?

The Journaling System automatically records every trade you take and transforms raw execution data into actionable insights.

 

Automatic Trade Capture

All fills from Rithmic are captured in real time.
No manual entries are required.

 

AI Powered Analysis
Open the "AI Settings" in the "Settings" section.

Receive daily AI generated summaries that highlight:

Strengths in your trading

Recurring mistakes

Behavioral and timing patterns

Clear improvement suggestions

Visual Analytics

Instant access to:

Calendar based profit and loss view

Equity curves

Win and loss distributions

Performance metrics at a glance

Interactive AI Chat

Ask questions about your trades and receive contextual coaching based on your actual execution data.
​

Key Benefit
What normally takes more than thirty minutes of manual journaling is completed automatically in seconds.

2. Getting Unlimited AI Access

By default, the system includes limited AI usage. Uploading your own API key unlocks unlimited summaries and deeper analysis.
​
​Open the "AI Settings" in the "Settings" section.

 

Why Upload Your Own API Key?

Without your own key:

Five AI requests per day

Shared system resources

Basic model quality

Zero monthly cost

With your own key:

Unlimited AI requests

Dedicated access

Ability to choose your preferred model

Approximately five to fifteen dollars per month based on usage

Supported AI Providers
OpenAI Recommended

Best suited for high quality analysis and consistent results.

Steps:

Go to platform.openai.com

Sign in or create an account

Navigate to the API Keys section

Click Create new secret key

Copy the key which starts with sk proj

Paste it into your journaling settings

Important note:
A payment method is required. Typical usage costs range from ten to fifty cents per daily summary.

Grok by xAI

Best suited for alternative perspectives and real time market context.

Steps:

Go to console.x.ai

Sign in using your X account

Navigate to API Keys

Create a new key

Paste the key into your journaling settings

How to Upload Your API Key

Navigate to Settings then AI Configuration

Select your provider

Paste your API key

Optionally click Test Key

Click Save

Security

API keys are encrypted using AES 128 encryption

Only the last four characters are visible in the interface

Keys are never stored or transmitted in plain text

Recommended Models

OpenAI GPT 4o mini - Approximate cost per summary is $0.10

OpenAI GPT 4o - Approximate cost per summary is $0.30

Grok grok beta - Cost varies based on xAI pricing

3. Daily Summary Workflow
What You Receive

Each daily AI summary includes:

Overall assessment of performance

What went well

Areas for improvement

Patterns noticed in behavior or execution

One clear focus for the next trading session

How to Generate a Daily Summary

Open the Journaling page

Select a date from the calendar

Review the captured trades

Click the Daily AI Summary button

Wait ten to fifteen seconds

Read your personalized analysis

First-time users without an API key will see a reminder about the five summaries per day limit.

What the AI Analyzes

For each trade:

Symbol traded

Long or short direction

Profit or loss in dollars

Entry and exit prices

Entry and exit timestamps

Trade duration

Contract quantity

Daily aggregated statistics include:

Total number of trades

Win and loss count and win rate

Total profit or loss

Largest winning trade

Largest losing trade

Average win compared to average loss

Interactive Follow-Up Questions

After your summary is generated, you can continue the conversation.

Examples:

Why did my afternoon trades perform worse

Should I have held that MNQ trade longer

What is the most common mistake in my losing trades

Do I trade better in the morning or the afternoon

The AI retains the full context of the conversation and all trades from that day.

 

Saved Summaries

Once generated, summaries are saved permanently. Visiting a past date loads the summary instantly without using additional AI requests.

4. Navigating Your Data
Calendar View

The calendar provides a monthly performance overview:

Green days indicate profitable sessions

Red days indicate losing sessions

Gray days indicate breakeven days or no trades

Daily profit or loss is displayed directly on each date

Click any date to view detailed trade data.

Trade List Table

For each selected date, the table displays:

Symbol

Side long or short

Quantity

Entry and exit prices

Entry and exit times

Duration

Profit or loss

Charts and Visualizations
Account Performance Chart

Displays:

Daily profit and loss bars

Cumulative equity curve

Dual-axis layout for clarity

Win and Loss Distribution

Displays:

Win percentage versus loss percentage

Total trade count in the center

Clear color-coded segments

Trade Details Modal

Clicking a trade opens a detailed view containing:

Full execution details

Performance metrics including ticks, R multiple, MAE, and MFE

Notes editor for personal observations

Trade tags such as A plus setup or revenge trade

Trade-specific AI coaching insights

Historical Data Sync

When you first access the journaling page, the system:

Detects your account creation date

Identifies missing historical trading days

Fetches data directly from Rithmic

Displays sync progress in real time

Caches data locally for instant future access

Final Takeaway

The Journaling System removes friction from trade review and replaces guesswork with structured, data-driven insight. If you trade consistently, this tool becomes one of your strongest performance advantages.

Opening Multiple Charts in Onyx
Opening Multiple Charts in Onyx

By default, Onyx allows only one active chart per Rithmic login session.

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM

Onyx allows you to monitor multiple markets and timeframes simultaneously using flexible chart layouts and pop-out chart windows.

 

Whether you prefer working within a single layout or across multiple screens, Onyx gives you full control over how you view and manage your charts.

 

Using Chart Layouts (Same Window)

You can display multiple charts within a single workspace using the built-in layout system.

How to Set Up Multiple Charts

Layout Setup:
Click the Layout icon at the top of your screen.

Select Grid:
Choose your preferred grid configuration. Onyx supports viewing multiple charts at the same time within one layout.

Change Symbols:
Click on any chart to change the symbol and track different markets (e.g., NQ, ES, CL) side by side.

This setup is ideal for keeping everything organized within a single window.

 


​

Using Pop-Out Charts (New)

You can now open charts in separate windows for a more advanced and flexible setup.

 

 

How It Works

Click the Pop-Out option on any chart

The chart opens in its own independent window

Each window can display a different symbol or account

All charts remain synced in real time

Benefits

Use multiple monitors for expanded visibility

Separate charts by strategy, symbol, or timeframe

Place trades directly from any chart window

No limit on the number of pop-out charts

This is the best option for traders who want a multi-screen or high-performance setup.

 

Best Way to Use Multiple Charts

Most traders combine both approaches:

Use layouts for quick monitoring inside one screen

Use pop-out charts for deeper focus across multiple screens

This gives you maximum flexibility depending on your workflow.

 

Using multiple charts is a great way to monitor correlated markets or different timeframes for the same instrument.

How to access and use the RTrader Pro mobile app for trading on the go.

Title: RTrader Pro Mobile App

Description: How to access and use the RTrader Pro mobile app for trading on the go.

The RTrader Pro mobile app allows you to monitor and manage your trades while away from your desktop.

Here’s how to get started:

Download the App: Visit the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android) and search for RTrader Pro.

Log In: Use your Rithmic username and password, just like on the desktop version. Be sure you’ve accepted the agreements on the desktop app first.

Monitor Your Positions: You can view open positions, orders, and account balances directly from the app.

Place and Manage Trades: Just like on the desktop version, you can place new orders, modify existing ones, or close positions right from the app.

Please note, functionality on the mobile app may be limited compared to the desktop version. For best results, use the mobile app primarily for monitoring trades and closing positions.

Risk Management - Rithmic rTrader

Set and manage auto liquidation in Rithmic to control risk, protect capital, and avoid unexpected losses using RTrader Pro tools.

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM
Overview

This guide explains how to configure Auto Liquidation settings in Rithmic using RTrader Pro. These tools help you manage risk and protect your account.

Setting Auto Liquidation Time

To manually set your account's auto liquidation time:

Open RTrader Pro.

Locate and right-click the account you wish to adjust.

Select "View Risk Parameters".

Click on the "Risk Parameters Set by the Trader" tab.

Set your preferred Auto Liquidation Time.

 

 

⚠️ Note: Auto liquidation times do not adjust automatically for daylight saving or standard time. You must update it manually as needed.

Managing Auto Liquidate Criteria

To further safeguard your trading account, RTrader Pro offers customizable auto liquidation criteria:

In RTrader Pro, open the Trader Panel.

Right-click your account.

Choose "Auto Liquidate Criteria".

Select your preferred method of risk control from the options below.

Available Criteria:

Minimum Account Balance: Triggers liquidation when your balance drops below a set threshold.

Percentage of Cash on Hand Lost: Liquidates your position if a predefined percentage of your account is lost.

Loss Limit: Defines a fixed dollar loss at which liquidation is triggered.

Trailing Minimum Account Balance: Tracks your high-water mark and liquidates if balance falls below a trailing limit.

Limited Trailing Minimum Account Balance: Same as trailing, but with a cap on how high the trailing balance can go.

 

⚠️ Be cautious when adjusting cash on hand or loss thresholds. Incorrect setup may lead to unexpected liquidation.

Final Tips

Always double-check your settings to ensure they align with your risk tolerance.

Consider consulting with Rithmic support if you're unsure about your configuration.

By using these tools wisely, you can better manage risk and protect your trading capital.

Troubleshooting rTrader Pro Login Issues

A guide to resolving common login issues with rTrader Pro.

October 22, 2026
Copy for LLM

If you're having trouble logging in to rTrader Pro, here are some steps you can follow to resolve the issue:

Ensure You Have the Correct Version: Make sure you're using the newest version of rTrader Pro. If you have an older version installed on your computer, uninstall them. Visit Rithmic to download the latest version.

Use the Correct Credentials: Don’t use your website login for rTrader Pro. You must use the rTrader Pro login and password provided to you in your member dashboard. Make sure you’re not typing your credentials—copying and pasting them can prevent any small errors.

Previously Logged In Without Issues?: If you could log in before, double-check your credentials for typos or extra spaces. Ensure your username and password are accurate.

Check Your Account Expiration: If your account has expired or you no longer have active accounts, you won’t be able to log in. To check your status, visit your members' area. If your account has expired, you’ll need to sign up for a new one.

Verify Address Information: Double-check that your address and zip code are correct in your profile, as incorrect details can prevent account creation and access.

If you're still experiencing issues after following these steps, it may be helpful to contact support for further assistance.
